correctness.rationale: The Haar pushforward is decomposed by the three mutually disjoint parity classes; odd power units are uniformly distributed on \(1+8\mathbb Z_2\), and both-even terms recurse after factoring \(2^d\). All normalizing factors are explicit. A sum of nonnegative geometric shell contributions gives exactly the \(L^s\) cutoff. The exact fibre and moment recurrences follow from the same probability decomposition, with separately checked first two levels. The four-variable collision formula follows by grouping ordered pairs with identical residue sums. The standalone integer checker independently reconstructs and agrees with complete finite residues for several exponents and depths.

value.rationale: For every even exponent with v_2(d)=1 beyond the quadratic case, a natural Waring map has its entire exact dyadic fibre distribution, collision count at all levels and sharp L^s phase transition determined. In particular sixth-power collision energy has exact base values and a geometric factor 4 per six levels, a structural consequence not obtained from ordinary solvability or a numerical census. This is a motivated arithmetic invariant useful in local density comparisons and singular fibre analysis, not a routine single input computation.
